quote.text: I have not kept any records and need to catch up

promise.text: Catch up on homeschool records without inventing dates

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "record"

lines.text: Rebuild missing homeschool records from dated evidence, separate facts from estimates, and restart today's log without pretending it is complete.

eyebrow.text: Rebuild one period at a time

items.text: Choose one child and a bounded period, such as October through December.
Gather workbooks, saved files, dated photos, submitted assignments and actual class records.
Keep plans, purchases and borrowed materials separate from evidence of completed activity.
Create entries showing the activity period, supporting evidence, uncertainty and date reconstructed.
Leave unsupported facts blank or explicitly unknown.
Attach evidence without changing original timestamps or relabeling old work as newly completed.

line.text: It works from whatever you give it. Record what you did, when you can remember it, and the record builds from there rather than demanding a full year up front.
